entries.name: control-negate-long-v3-accept#0
entries.script: [N0] `-(1L)` at tree v3 — THE CONTROL. Long -1 at cost 35: an honest value, so the negation returns and every refusal below is about the VALUE, not about Negation itself.

entries.name: control-negate-long-v0-accept#1
entries.script: [N0] `-(1L)` at tree v0 — the control's v0 twin, also Long -1 at 35.

entries.name: negate-narrow-value-v3-errored#2
entries.script: [N1] `-If(false, 1L, 2)` at tree v3 — a Long-typed input with an Int VALUE. Negation takes ArithOp.impls(input.tpe.typeCode) (trees.scala:885-890) and casts the value to it, so the Integer is cast to Long: ClassCastException. The static type decides, not the value.

entries.name: negate-narrow-value-v0-errored#3
entries.script: [N1] `-If(false, 1L, 2)` at tree v0 — throws at v0 TOO: a unary node has nothing to upcast, so no version gate exists here.

entries.name: negate-wide-value-v3-errored#4
entries.script: [N2] `-If(false, 1, 2L)` at tree v3 — THE MIRROR: an Int-typed input with a Long VALUE, i.e. a value WIDER than its static type. Negation takes ArithOp.impls(input.tpe.typeCode) (trees.scala:885-890) and casts the value to it, so the Long is cast DOWN to Integer: ClassCastException the other way. The static type decides in BOTH directions, so refusing only a narrow value is not the rule.

entries.name: negate-wide-value-v0-errored#5
entries.script: [N2] `-If(false, 1, 2L)` at tree v0 — throws at v0 TOO: a unary node has nothing to upcast, so no version gate exists here.

entries.name: negate-if-honest-long-v3-accept#6
entries.script: [N3] `-If(false, 1L, 2L)` at tree v3 — THE HONEST TWIN of N1: the same shape with a Long in the false branch. Long -2 at cost 50 (the If's 20 + Negation's 30), which makes N1's refusal about the VALUE and not about negating an If.

entries.name: negate-if-honest-long-v0-accept#7
entries.script: [N3] `-If(false, 1L, 2L)` at tree v0 — the twin's v0 twin, also Long -2 at 50.

entries.name: if-false-int-long-v3-accept#8
entries.script: [L1] `If(false, 1, 2L)` alone at tree v3 — THE MIRROR LEVER: an Int-typed expression evaluating to a Long 2 at cost 20, `If.tpe` being the TRUE branch's. It must keep returning a LONG or N2 demonstrates nothing.

entries.name: if-false-int-long-v0-accept#9
entries.script: [L1] `If(false, 1, 2L)` alone at tree v0 — unchanged at v0: the If is indifferent to the version.
